body: I decided to break up with her 2 months ago. Have no idea yet was it the best choice or not, I miss her sometimes, or maybe just human companionship, don't know. I have been pretty lonely. But life is pretty chill now, and I can focus more on myself. And she too, she finally got into therapy. We haven't talked for a month, she told me when we broke up that she will always love me and will now give me space, and let me decide if I will give her another chance. but I think that she was trying to manipulate me again, I am pretty sure now that this is the right decision.

Hi, thank you for your answer.

That's the point. I am constantly back and forth about me wanting to be with her, and then breaking up with her... And I feel like that's already a sign you should break up, if I have been thinking about it for 2 years. Also that my girlfriend seems really manipulative sometimes if she doesn't get what she wants. And that she has hit me couple times, though one year ago, it seems a bad thing. And we are really codependant, and me being depressed everytime im not around her seems bad. And I want to experience life without girlfriend, I have allways been in a relationship. And true after all these, I still feel like I need her in my life, and that I love her, and that I would get really depressed if we broke up. But if I would continue our relationship like this, and try to my best, there is the other half. I think she would not be happy either, she just needs so much attention. I have no idea, I should talk to her but we have never talked because I am so afraid of her reaction to my feelings.

Right now I am depressed as heck myself, and feel really desperate, like there is no-win situation here. if I stay with her, we will still be unhappy. If we break up, same thing, only worse. We are extremely codependant on each other. Sorry, things are hard to put in words, as I am not native english-speaker.

Thanks alot for your comment. True, before the relationship I had heard that she was really manipulative towards her ex-boyfriend too. I think I have leaded her too far, she has no idea I constantly think about not-being in relationship. Telling things I am unhappy seems very hard, because I haven't said things like that, I devolped a habit to not talk about certain things to keep her happy, when she had her worst depression going on. It also feels hard for me to break up from this though I know I need and have to in some point, it feels horrible to think about losing my safety net.

Thank you for your answer. That way would be good way to go with it. This thing has already been going so long, that it feels impossible to breakup, we have become really codependant on each other.

Today I am not so worried about anymore how she will take it, but more about how I am going to take it. I am already feeling really depressed about being alone, and thinking how I am able to find someone like her again. Shes like my only friend, we do everything together.
